hypotheses.construction_plan: Instantiate B(x)*A(x)^2 with the given mapping. The raw terms become this template under AC permutation: V(p)*G0(p)*V(p) -> G0(p)*V(p)^2 and W(q)*H0(q)*W(q) -> H0(q)*W(q)^2.
required_assumptions: Function values multiply commutatively and associatively
Each term is a scalar monomial in one variable
hypotheses.rationale: Both summands share the same two-function monomial structure: a central function times the square of a repeated flanking function, up to multiplicative commutativity.
